title: Token system refresh: palette, type scale, spacing & elevation
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary: Refresh and consolidate Redwood Inference design tokens for color palettes, typographic scale, spacing/radius, and elevation/shadow values. Goal is improved accessibility contrast, consistent rhythm across components, smaller token surface area, and a clear migration path for engineering.

Scope:
- Replace current ad-hoc color swatches with semantic color tokens (primary/neutral/critical/success/warn/disabled + surface variants).
- Introduce a 9-step typographic scale (ui-xxs..ui-xl) mapped to rem values and token names used by CSS/JS. Align headings, body, and UI text.
- Standardize spacing tokens on a 4px baseline with scale tokens (space-0..space-9) and radius tokens (radius-0..radius-4).
- Add elevation tokens (elev-0..elev-4) with platform-adjusted shadow definitions for web and native.
- Update component tokens for Button, Table, Chart, Input, and Badge to consume new tokens.
- Provide codemods and migration docs for engineering to swap old token names to new ones.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Design tokens are implemented in tokens.json and tokens.scss and exported in the component library build.
2) All core components (Button, Table, Chart, Input, Badge) visually match design specs in Figma with no regressions.
3) Contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for body text and >= 3:1 for secondary labels according to WCAG AA where applicable.
4) Migration guide and codemods available in the repo with example PR (referenced below).
5) Release notes drafted and rollout plan approved by PM and Eng.

Proposed token highlights (examples):
- Colors (semantic): color-primary-500 (#2468FF), color-primary-300 (#7EA9FF), color-surface-0 (#FFFFFF), color-surface-1 (#F7F9FC), color-neutral-700 (#1F2933), color-critical-600 (#D84444), color-success-600 (#179A6B).
- Type: ui-xxs: 0.75rem / 12px, ui-xs: 0.8125rem / 13px, ui-sm: 0.875rem / 14px, ui-base: 1rem / 16px, ui-lg: 1.125rem / 18px, ui-xl: 1.25rem / 20px, heading-md: 1.5rem / 24px, heading-lg: 2rem / 32px. Line-height tokens: leading-tight, leading-normal, leading-comfort.
- Spacing/radius: space-0: 0px, space-1: 4px, space-2: 8px, space-3: 12px, space-4: 16px, space-5: 24px, radius-0: 0px, radius-1: 4px, radius-2: 8px.
- Elevation/shadows (web examples): elev-0: none; elev-1: 0 1px 2px rgba(17,24,39,0.04), 0 1px 0 rgba(17,24,39,0.02); elev-2: 0 4px 12px rgba(17,24,39,0.06); elev-3: 0 12px 30px rgba(17,24,39,0.10).

Migration notes:
- Provide mapping CSV between old token keys and new semantic tokens.
- Implement two codemods: (1) CSS/SCSS variable rename, (2) JS token object key rename.
- Add feature flag in component library to support legacy tokens for two release cycles.

Risks & trade-offs:
- Slight visual shift for existing apps; mitigate with migration guide and feature flag.
- Some charts rely on specific palette hues; chart team to validate colorblind-safe palettes (Daltonize test).

Deliverables & timeline:
- Week 1 (Feb 24 - Mar 1) — final design decisions, token list, Figma components updated.
- Week 2 (Mar 2 - Mar 8) — design tokens implemented in repo, initial component refactors (Button, Input).
- Week 3 (Mar 9 - Mar 15) — codemods, Table & Chart updates, accessibility QA.
- Week 4 (Mar 16 - Mar 31) — rollout, PRs merged, release notes, engineering adoption.

Artifacts & links:
- Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/RedwoodDesignSystem/Token-Refresh-2026
- Design spec doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rdsampledesignspec
- Example PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/1248
- Codemod repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/codemods/tree/main/token-migrations

QA checklist:
- Visual diff against baseline snapshots for Button, Table, Chart.
- Automated contrast checks in Storybook.
- Manual pass on the most-used pages (Console routes, Model details, Billing).

Rollback plan:
- If visual regressions discovered post-release: revert token package to legacy feature-flag path and ship hotfix; small subset of apps can opt-in to new tokens when ready.

2026-03-06 - Samira Nguyen (Design): Uploaded Figma frames for new type scale and spacing tokens. Linked to above Figma file. Note: increased body size to ui-base 16px to improve readability at small sizes.

2026-03-11 - Design review: Reviewed with design leadership. Decision: adopt elev-3 as default card shadow in Console lists. Follow-up: update Storybook tokens and snapshot tests.
